address: Al Qana Marina South, Al Maqta’ Street, Abu Dhabi
bio: Meaning ‘hi’ in Portuguese, Oii is located in Al Qana Marina, next to The National Aquarium. On the inside, this relaxed and casual spot is light and airy, thanks to its floor to ceiling windows, while the outside’s spacious, shaded terrace is ideal al fresco dining. Expect a wide-ranging breakfast menu, followed by a Mediterranean-inspired selection of smaller and larger colourful plates, snacks and salads. One way to start your meal is with a grilled octopus with vibrant mojo rojo, followed by the spiced peri peri baby chicken and finish with fruity passion fruit semi freddo.
